text:
marta: Quick design review — QA flagged the rollback toast copy as ambiguous. It currently says `Rollback applied` but folks aren't sure what traffic state changed. Can we make it clearer and tie it to timeline history?
kevin: Agree. Also disappears too fast. We should add a short CTA like 'View history' and maybe extend duration for 10s. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: Accessibility: aria-live should announce the outcome. Something like 'Deployment rolled back to version 11' announced by screen readers. Focus shouldn't jump unexpectedly.
devon: Copy options: A) 'Rollback complete — serving v11 (100% traffic)'. B) 'Rollback executed: version 11 is live'. I prefer A — concise and includes traffic percent.
lina: Can the toast include a small info chevron that anchors to that timeline entry? Clicking opens the history drawer. Keeps toast compact.
kevin: We can add that. Concern: duplicate info in toast + timeline. Proposed pattern: toast short + CTA; timeline stores full details and undo action.
sara: A11y nit: selected timeline row contrast is ~3.3:1 now. Need >=4.5:1 for body text. Also voiceover reads the raw ISO timestamp; let's surface humanized time (eg '2 minutes ago') and include full time in tooltip.
devon: Also microcopy for canary controls — 'Pause' is ambiguous. Suggest 'Pause new traffic' vs 'Pause rollout' so it's clear we stop sending new requests to the variant.
marta: Recap proposal: 1) toast -> "Rollback complete — serving v11 (100% traffic)" + 'View history' CTA 2) toast persists 10s and is aria-live=polite 3) timeline item includes full diff, user who triggered, 'Undo' button with aria-label 'Undo rollback, restores previous traffic allocation' 4) timeline selected state color token updated for 4.5:1 contrast 5) timestamps humanized + full timestamp in tooltip 6) change canary 'Pause' copy to 'Pause new traffic'
kevin: I'll own the SRE changes (toast duration + aria-live) and add a flag to expose the timeline anchor url.
maya: I'll handle the a11y labels and timeline SR announcement wording.
lina: I'll update the Figma frames for toast variants (short + with CTA) and add a tiny chevron micro-interaction.
sara: I'll open a quick accessibility issue for contrast and timestamp reading.
devon: I'll PR the copy variants and add tests for the rollback undo aria-label.
designbot: Checklist: copy updated, a11y labels added, color token bumped, keyboard focus states, timeline anchor implemented.
marta: Thanks team — assigning tasks in Asana. I'll push the figma link in the thread when ready. :thumbsup:
